g.text: From sender A to recipient B: the complete journey
Teams stores the message. Azure stores the read model, pushes a hint, then serves the recipient's read.
1 / SEND AND STORE - successful delegated-send path
2 / DELIVER A HINT, THEN FETCH CONTENT - B is authorized, connected and viewing the conversation
Publish work before the feed checkpoint
WebSocket push = conversation ID + revision. Message bodies arrive in the authorized Api response.
Sender confirmation is not proof of recipient display. Matching Teams notifications can reach the same read model.
Delivery feed + fan-out are one app role | Connected browser push, not mobile notifications
